description: Fork of exp513 (1.4825, 89.4M, E=64). ONLY change: embedding_dim E 64 -> 96. Tests the narrow attention bus. Key structural quirk this removes: exp513 has H*d_v=96 -> out_proj n_out=E=64, an implicit 33% compression of SDPA output every layer; with E=96 out_proj becomes 96->96, lossless. Widens tok_emb_E (+1.05M), qkv_lut/v_lut/residual_lut input encodings (small), and out_proj n_out (~+50% this module). D=384, head Linear(384,V) unchanged. Adjudication via curve shape vs exp513: steepened late slope (3000->8000 better than -0.0234/k) -> attention bus was the bottleneck; uniform offset only -> capacity-not-gradient (like exp566); ~= exp513 -> E=64 not binding. Complementary to D-sweep (exp562-565 widened residual; this widens attention bus). Refs: exp562 D=512 = 1.4714 @ 99.9M; exp566 MLP head = 1.4891 @ 110.76M; vanilla bs=16 exp328 = 1.3882 @ 23.2M.
